osps_ac_01_01_justification: Two-factor authentication is required for every member of the monumental-archive organisation, an organisation-level setting, so it covers write access to every repository and access to its private vulnerability reports. GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, records it among the organisation's security settings. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#escalation-and-permissions
osps_ac_03_01_justification: An organisation-level ruleset on every repository's default branch requires every change to arrive as a pull request and pass the required status check, and blocks direct pushes. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The organisation-level ruleset on every repository's default branch blocks its deletion and any force push. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
osps_br_01_01_justification: Every repository runs the organisation's shared gate as a required status check on its default branch, and the gate runs zizmor over every tracked workflow: it fails on template-injection patterns where untrusted event or input data would reach a shell, so such a workflow cannot merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/mise/config.toml
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow that runs caller-supplied code may hold `id-token: write`: lint:capability-boundary, in the shared gate every repository runs as a required status check, fails the build if one does, and the organisation's signing identity is minted only in the shared release workflows, never in a job that runs this repository's code. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/mise/config.toml
osps_br_01_04_justification: Every repository runs the organisation's shared gate as a required status check on its default branch, and the gate runs zizmor over every tracked workflow: it fails on template-injection patterns where untrusted event or input data would reach a shell, so such a workflow cannot merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/mise/config.toml
osps_br_07_01_justification: Secret scanning with push protection is enabled and enforced on every public repository by the organisation's security configuration, so a credential matching a known pattern is blocked at push time. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/security/org-default.json
osps_do_02_01_justification: SUPPORT.md and the issue forms, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health files, document how to report a defect, and SECURITY.md documents the separate private path for vulnerabilities. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
osps_do_04_01_justification: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, states the scope and duration of support in 'Supported versions and end of life': only the latest release receives security updates, fixes ship by rolling forward from main, and a release is supported until the next one exists. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions-and-end-of-life
osps_do_05_01_justification: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, states when a release stops receiving security updates: at the point the next release exists, since fixes ship only by rolling forward from main. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions-and-end-of-life
osps_gv_01_02_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, carries a 'Roles and responsibilities' table naming three roles - maintainer/owner, contributor, automation - and the responsibilities of each; the maintainer role is the @monumental-archive/owners team. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Issues are enabled on every repository by the organisation's repository baseline, which the Monday audit checks every repository against, and every change arrives as a public pull request under the organisation ruleset; both are open for discussion and addressable by URL. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/settings/repo-baseline.json
osps_gv_03_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, explains the contribution process: an issue first for anything large, pull requests for small self-contained fixes, Conventional Commits, DCO sign-off, a green `mise run ci`, squash merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_gv_03_02_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, has a 'Requirements for acceptable contributions' section: pull request only, a green `mise run ci`, a check for every change in behaviour, Conventional Commits, squash merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
osps_gv_04_01_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, carries the policy in 'Escalation and permissions': a collaborator is reviewed before being granted any escalated permission, and the grant is recorded in the settings-as-code baseline. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#escalation-and-permissions
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit must carry a Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1 sign-off, as CONTRIBUTING.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file) states; lint:dco in the shared gate, a required status check, rejects a commit without one. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The shared gate is a required status check (`ci / ci`) under the organisation-level ruleset on every repository's default branch: a pull request cannot merge red, and direct pushes are blocked. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
osps_qa_06_01_justification: Every repository runs the shared gate, its full `mise run ci`, on every pull request, and the organisation-level ruleset makes it a required status check, so a change cannot be accepted until it passes. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
osps_qa_06_02_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, documents when and how the tests run: `mise run ci` locally is exactly the check CI runs, and every pull request must pass it. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
osps_qa_06_03_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, item 3 of 'Requirements for acceptable contributions': a change that adds or changes behaviour adds the check that holds it, and a bug fix adds the case that reproduced the bug. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The organisation-level ruleset on every repository's default branch requires a pull request but no approving review, so a non-author approval is not enforced; with one maintainer there is no one to give it. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
osps_vm_01_01_justification: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, is the coordinated disclosure policy: private reporting through the repository's Security tab, acknowledgement within 14 days, and coordinated disclosure. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, names the reporting channel: private vulnerability reporting through the repository's Security tab. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled and enforced on every public repository by the organisation's security configuration, and SECURITY.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file) names it as the channel. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/security/org-default.json
osps_vm_06_01_justification: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, section 'Static analysis policy', sets the remediation threshold at zero: any finding fails the shared gate, and a red gate cannot merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#static-analysis-policy
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL default setup is enabled and enforced on every public repository by the organisation's security configuration, and the shared gate's static checks run on every pull request as a required status check that blocks the merge on a finding. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/security/org-default.json
code_of_conduct_justification: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
code_review_standards_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, section 'Code review', documents what a reviewer checks and what makes a change acceptable, and records that with one maintainer the gate is the compensating control. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#code-review
coding_standards_enforced_justification: Automatically: the shared gate runs the toolbelt's linters on every pull request as a required status check, under the organisation-level ruleset on every repository's default branch. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
coding_standards_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, names the organisation's CI gate as the coding standard in executable form; its checks are delivered to every repository by the shared toolbelt. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, section 'Requirements for acceptable contributions'. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, documents the process: issue first for large changes, pull request, Conventional Commits, DCO sign-off, a green `mise run ci`, squash merge. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dco_justification: Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1, required by CONTRIBUTING.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file); lint:dco in the shared gate, a required status check, rejects a commit without a Signed-off-by trailer. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
discussion_justification: Issues are enabled on every repository by the organisation's repository baseline, which the Monday audit checks every repository against, and every change arrives as a pull request under the organisation ruleset: both are searchable, addressable by URL and open to new participants. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/settings/repo-baseline.json
governance_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, documents the decision model, roles and succession. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
report_archive_justification: Issues are enabled on every repository by the organisation's repository baseline, which the Monday audit checks every repository against; the GitHub issue tracker is public, searchable and kept. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/settings/repo-baseline.json
report_process_justification: SUPPORT.md and the issue forms, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health files, say bug reports go through GitHub Issues on the relevant repository. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
report_tracker_justification: Issues are enabled on every repository by the organisation's repository baseline, which the Monday audit checks every repository against, and SUPPORT.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file) names GitHub Issues as the tracker. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/settings/repo-baseline.json
require_2FA_justification: Two-factor authentication is required for every member of the monumental-archive organisation, an organisation-level setting, so it covers write access to every repository and access to its private vulnerability reports. GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, records it among the organisation's security settings. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#escalation-and-permissions
roles_responsibilities_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, carries a 'Roles and responsibilities' table; the maintainer role is the @monumental-archive/owners team. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities
static_analysis_often_justification: On every change: the shared gate runs on every pull request and every push to the default branch, as a required status check under the organisation-level ruleset. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/docs/rulesets.md
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL default setup is enabled and enforced on every public repository by the organisation's security configuration, and the shared gate runs the belt's static checks over every tracked file on every pull request, before any release. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/security/org-default.json
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, item 3 of 'Requirements for acceptable contributions', is the written policy: a change that adds or changes behaviour adds the check that holds it. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
tests_documented_added_justification: The policy is in the instructions for change proposals: CONTRIBUTING.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file), item 3 of 'Requirements for acceptable contributions'. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-for-acceptable-contributions
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled and enforced on every public repository by the organisation's security configuration, and SECURITY.md (served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file) names it as the channel. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/security/org-default.json
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, publishes the process: private reporting through the repository's Security tab. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY.md, served to every repository in the organisation as a default community health file, documents the process: private reporting, acknowledgement within 14 days, coordinated remediation and disclosure through a security advisory. https://github.com/monumental-archive/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md
